title: How should acceptance requirements be written when buying seven wind-turbine-flange heat-treatment furnaces?
summary: A group of Suneng proposals for wind-power flange production includes 5 gas-fired chamber furnaces and one bogie-hearth electric furnace in each of two sizes. Equipment quantities can be totalled, but loading, temperature control and acceptance must remain linked to individual furnaces. Even the five equally sized gas furnaces have two different temperature-testing groups; one acceptable result cannot generically represent the entire purchase.
coverCaption: Illustration of forged flanges (AI-generated). Not an actual customer workpiece photograph. One category of objects covered by this article.
